segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Hi, I'm the AI interviewer. Thanks for making time today. This is a relaxed conversation about your experience, and you can ask me about the role along the way. Ready to start?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Yes, ready. Thanks for having me.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Great. To warm up, tell me a bit about what you're working on right now.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: I lead a small platform team. We run the services behind payments, mostly Go and PostgreSQL.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Your résumé says you migrated 40 services to Kubernetes. How did you decide what to move first?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: We started with the stateless services that had the best test coverage.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: That makes sense. Looking back, what would you do differently next time?
